title: webhooks.sign
description: Headers of a webhook delivery (BE-WH-14..17). hmac: X-Lago-Signature = Base64 (standard alphabet, padded, no line breaks) of HMAC-SHA256(key = organization hmac key as UTF-8 bytes, message = exact body bytes). jwt: X-Lago-Signature = compact JWS RS256 with protected header exactly {"alg":"RS256"}, claims {"data": <body string>, "iss": <issuer>} serialised as compact JSON (keys in this order; characters other than '"' '\\' and those below U+0020 written raw), base64url without padding, signed RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 SHA-256 with the installation private key. X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm = hmac|jwt; X-Lago-Unique-Key = the delivery row id; Content-Type = application/json.

hmac_key.x-kit-absent: unused for jwt; for hmac a key is required by the vector

rsa_private_key_pem.description: PEM private key of the installation (kit vectors use the kit's test-only key).

iss.description: Issuer claim = the API's public base URL.
